name: X
description: Post, reply, quote, poll, search, read mentions, like and repost on X through the v2 API (api.x.com/2). Authentication is OAuth 2.0 with PKCE against an account connected once with `degen-portal connect x`; the access token lasts two hours and is refreshed automatically, and neither it nor the refresh token is ever printed. Writes are billed per call under X's pay-per-use pricing.
